name: CSD201 — Luyện tập Cấu trúc dữ liệu & Giải thuật bằng Java (chạy & tự chấm trên máy)
description: Bộ luyện môn CSD201 (Data Structures and Algorithms, Java) theo từng bài học: độ phức tạp, mảng động, danh sách liên kết đơn/vòng/kép, ngăn xếp, hàng đợi, hàng đợi ưu tiên, đệ quy, cây nhị phân, BST, AVL, heap, đồ thị (BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, cây khung nhỏ nhất, Euler), sắp xếp, băm, xử lý văn bản (KMP, Huffman, LZW, RLE), ⭐ thuật toán phỏng vấn và đề PE đúng khuôn trường (MyList/BSTree/Graph đọc data.txt, ghi f1.txt…). Website KHÔNG chấm: mỗi đề tải về một thư mục (code khởi đầu + máy chấm cham.mjs + ca mẫu), bạn làm trên máy với JDK của mình rồi chạy "node cham.mjs" — nó biên dịch bằng javac --release 8, chạy nhiều ca (có ca ẩn), so output từng dòng có diff, đi theo đúng các liên kết head/next/prev/left/right của cấu trúc bạn dựng (reflection), đo độ phức tạp trên input lớn có hạn giờ rồi cho điểm; đạt hết thì bấm "Tự đánh dấu đã giải".

modules.name: 0.3 Big-O: the language of efficiency
modules.description: Luyện: arrayMax: count the primitive operations · Count without counting: closed forms for seven loops · Linear vs binary search: count the probes, then search a million times

modules.name: 0.5 🧪 Practice — complexity in code: prefix sums, duplicates, doubling, a PE-style CarList
modules.description: Luyện: Prefix sums: answer 200,000 range-sum queries · Find a duplicate in O(n): from all pairs to a HashSet · A flexible array that doubles: amortized O(1) append · CarList f1–f4 on an array: max, range count, stable sort, binary search

modules.name: 1.1 Arrays & dynamic arrays
modules.description: Luyện: MyArrayList: insert and remove at an index by shifting · Remove every occurrence in one pass (two indexes) · Rotate an array by k in place: three reversals

modules.name: 1.2 Singly, circular & doubly linked lists
modules.description: Luyện: Singly linked list: addFirst, addLast in O(1), removeFirst, removeLast · insertAt(k, x) and deleteAt(k) on a singly linked list · A circular list with only a tail: add, remove, rotate in O(1) · Doubly linked list: O(1) at both ends, links checked both ways

modules.name: 1.3 Doubly linked lists with sentinels
modules.description: Luyện: Header and trailer sentinels: every operation through addBetween and remove · A sorted doubly linked list with sentinels: insertSorted and removeAll · Browser history on a doubly linked list: visit, back, forward

modules.name: 1.4 Java in practice: ArrayList vs LinkedList
modules.description: Luyện: Remove while iterating: Iterator.remove on any List · Merge two sorted Lists with iterators, whatever their class · Pick the right structure: a ticket queue of 400,000 customers

modules.name: 1.5 Three classic list problems: reverse, cycle, merge
modules.description: Luyện: Reverse a singly linked list in place — the same nodes, no recursion · Floyd’s tortoise and hare: find where the cycle starts, in O(1) memory · Merge two sorted linked lists by relinking — not one new node

modules.name: 1.6 🧪 Practice — Josephus, palindrome list and a 🎯 PE-format MyList paper
modules.description: Luyện: The Josephus circle on a circular linked list · Is the linked list a palindrome? O(n) time, O(1) memory, list restored · 🎯 PE format — MyList of Cars: f1 addLast with a condition, f2 insert as 3rd, f3 delete the first max, f4 stable sort

modules.name: 2.1 Stacks (LIFO) & Queues (FIFO)
modules.description: Luyện: A linked stack: push, pop, top — all at the head · A linked queue: enqueue at the tail, dequeue at the head, both O(1) · Reverse the first k elements of a queue with a stack

modules.name: 2.2 Implementing stacks & queues: circular array vs linked
modules.description: Luyện: An array stack that grows correctly (and the off-by-one in top) · Circular array queue with first/last as on the slides — wrap around, then grow in queue order · A queue made of two stacks: amortized O(1)

modules.name: 2.3 Stack applications: brackets, RPN, undo
modules.description: Luyện: Balanced brackets — and where the first error is · Evaluate a postfix (RPN) expression · Infix to postfix with the shunting-yard algorithm · Undo and redo with two stacks

modules.name: 2.4 Deques & the sliding-window maximum
modules.description: Luyện: A deque on a circular array: add and remove at both ends in O(1) · Sliding window maximum in O(n) with a monotonic deque · First negative number in every window of size k

modules.name: 2.5 Priority Queues & Heaps
modules.description: Luyện: A priority queue on a binary min-heap: insert and removeMin in O(log n) · The k largest of a million numbers with a heap of size k · Emergency triage: severity first, then arrival order, with a Comparator

modules.name: 2.6 🧪 Practice — round-robin, a patient queue (PE), monotonic stacks
modules.description: Luyện: A round-robin CPU scheduler with a queue · PE style: a patient priority queue on a sorted linked list (f1–f4) · Next greater element with a monotonic stack · Largest rectangle in a histogram (stack, O(n))

modules.name: 3.1 Recursion & the call stack
modules.description: Luyện: Sum, count and maximum of an array — recursively · Reverse a string and test a palindrome — recursively · Decimal to any base from 2 to 16 — the digits come out on the way back

modules.name: 3.2 The four classic recursions
modules.description: Luyện: Towers of Hanoi: the moves, and how many there are · Fibonacci: from exponential to linear with memoization · Fast power: aⁿ mod m with O(log n) multiplications

modules.name: 3.3 Analysing recursion: recursion trees & the Master theorem
modules.description: Luyện: How many calls does naive fib(n) make? Solve the recurrence, do not run it · Count inversions in O(n log n) — merge sort with a counter · Maximum subarray by divide and conquer (best crossing the middle)

modules.name: 3.4 Designing recursion & eliminating tail calls
modules.description: Luyện: Eliminate the tail call: three tail-recursive functions become loops · Flood fill with an explicit stack: regions of a 2000 × 2000 map · A recursive-descent calculator: expression → term → factor

modules.name: 3.5 🧪 Practice — list recursion, backtracking, N queens, memoized grid paths
modules.description: Luyện: PE style: count, sum, max and print backwards on a linked list — recursively · Backtracking: subsets with a given sum, and permutations in order · N queens: count every placement and print the first one · Grid paths with obstacles: recursion + memo instead of 10¹⁶ calls
